kind: authored interpretation of archived matched-feature study
source_changes_from_surface: Only rich-features-native.sh addition and surface-report.py helper update; rich driver, all primitive headers and CMake unchanged.
scope: Same frozen rich-format driver/header source for all tiers and hosts; script/report additions only.
AVX2 and AVX2+GFNI are feature-matched across hosts; native enables additional platform-specific features.
No cache-residence claim; allocated payload, query state and shared controls all occupy memory.
Three rotated process passes; each cell below is the median of eight internal repetitions per process.
All five complete operations/tails/layouts retained; raw fused independently encodes and routes the same bytes.
This is a primitive composition control, not a complete hash table or a multi-writer result.

F7+C13 is an independent packing-composition stress case, not clamp-derived hash geometry: Kb<8 implies Kc=0. Its GFNI speedup must not be claimed for default F8 K40 tables. No hashing/table cost is included.

Native extra features are not uniformly best: Zen5 one-bucket F7 6B changed-update active1 is9.467ns native vs5.093ns AVX2+GFNI. All tails/operations and per-process repetitions are available in summary.json and raw CSVs in the archive.

flags.shared: -fno-vectorize -fno-slp-vectorize -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off; exact full command in each tier compile.json

codegen: Each SP/TP split6 getter is call-free. AVX2+GFNI and native have one vgf2p8affineqb and no stack access. Native also uses exact14B masked byte load and mask-register equality; AVX2+GFNI uses bounded scalar assembly of14B plus movemask. Instruction count alone does not establish throughput mechanism.
